title: Updates to GitHub Copilot billing and plans
Evaluation models in auto for individual plans
summary: GitHub Copilot offers access to evaluation models for individual non-enterprise users, and these models may be served in Copilot auto model selection.[^c-affa47e284]

title: GitHub Copilot app: The agent-native desktop experience
summary: At Microsoft Build 2026, GitHub introduced new tools, updates, and surfaces so agents can work the way you already work.[^c-b202022100] While the agentic shift has made development faster, it’s also led to disjointed workflows, more context switching, and too much time spent reviewing agent-generated code.[^c-a30546f6e5] If agents are going to be a durable part of how software gets built, they need a real place in the developer workflow.[^c-1c5d442cbe]

title: Gemini models in Copilot CLI, cloud agent, and the Copilot app
summary: Two Gemini models are now available across additional GitHub Copilot surfaces.[^c-5c32a32cd1]

title: Introducing Copilot CLI and agentic capabilities enhancements in JetBrains IDEs
summary: With Copilot CLI now available in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs, this update centers on new capabilities for Copilot CLI sessions, while also delivering a broader set of agentic improvements.[^c-111fbf7efd] For Copilot CLI sessions, that includes agent picker support, new slash commands, and the agent debug panel in public preview, along with the beginning of a phased transition to Copilot CLI agent as the default experience.[^c-7521662809]

title: GitHub Copilot in Eclipse: BYOK, skills, and chat updates
GitHub Copilot code review for Azure Repos is now in technical preview
summary: GitHub Copilot code review for Azure Repos is now available in technical preview, bringing on demand pull request reviews directly into your Azure DevOps workflow.[^c-4939283b68]

title: MAI-Code-1-Flash is now available for GitHub Copilot
Copilot CLI: Improved UI, rubber duck, prompt scheduling, and voice input
summary: GitHub Copilot CLI is getting a major refresh at Microsoft Build 2026.[^c-b92e7dc7da]

title: Extend GitHub with agent apps
summary: Agent apps are AI agents from GitHub partners, installable from the GitHub Marketplace, and integrated directly into GitHub.[^c-6c94a3ef63] You install an agent app just like any other GitHub App from the Marketplace.[^c-bb7f2d96c0]

title: Expanded technical preview availability for the GitHub Copilot app
summary: The GitHub Copilot app technical preview is now available to all existing Copilot Pro, Pro+, Business, and Enterprise customers.[^c-540a078ab9] Download the Copilot app for Windows, macOS, or Linux to get started.[^c-8f3731e7a5] Access for Copilot Free users and new subscribers will be opening soon.[^c-69a38e28bd]

title: Copilot Memory supports user preferences for Business, Enterprise
Schedule and automate tasks with Copilot cloud agent
summary: With the new automations feature, Copilot cloud agent can now run automatically, on a schedule or in response to repository events.[^c-7e3fbd6315] Automations let you hand off repetitive tasks to the agent without any manual input.[^c-3f4591e310]

title: Gain insights across your agent sessions with /chronicle
summary: Every Copilot session you run (e.g., fixing a bug, reviewing code, spinning up a feature) builds a history only you can query. /chronicle turns that history into standup summaries, personalized tips, and custom instructions that make Copilot work better for you over time.[^c-d34b32c639]

title: Shape Copilot code review around your team
summary: Copilot code review adapts to your team’s tools and standards and scales its depth to the complexity of each change.[^c-9d543120da]

title: Copilot SDK is now generally available
summary: The GitHub Copilot SDK is now generally available.[^c-86bc1ee9c9] You can embed GitHub Copilot’s agentic engine into your own applications, services, and developer tools with a stable API and production-ready support.[^c-b0aba406b3]

title: Cloud and local sandboxes for GitHub Copilot now in public preview
summary: GitHub Copilot can now run inside secure, isolated sandboxes, both locally on your machine and in the cloud.[^c-cf2a9386ec] Sandboxed Copilot experiences provide isolated environments for Copilot’s tool execution locally as well as fully isolated cloud sandboxes hosted by GitHub.[^c-38d09b3084]

title: What’s Coming Next in Visual Studio: Our Microsoft Build 2026 Announcements
summary: Microsoft Build kicks off today in San Francisco, June 2 and 3.[^c-d97ec70371]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio Code, May releases
summary: VS Code continues with weekly stable releases.[^c-899675f9eb]

title: Session sync and chronicle
summary: Your chat sessions now sync automatically to your GitHub account, giving you a personal, searchable history of your work across machines and workspaces.[^c-9e6cc09b3d] Each session captures the conversation, the files you touched, repository context (repo, branch, timestamps), and any pull requests, issues, or commits referenced along the way.[^c-a12f8dee86]

title: Retry network-dependent commands in the sandbox
summary: When a terminal command that is run by a _local_ agent requires access to domains that are not configured as allowed domains, the command is automatically retried inside the sandbox with unrestricted network access.[^c-49bb0ddb43] After that, if it still fails, it falls back to unsandboxed execution.[^c-7e58ac97ae]

title: Agents window (Preview)
summary: The Agents window is a dedicated companion window optimized for exploring, iterating on, and reviewing agent sessions across projects and machines.[^c-9217f12668]

title: Research agent (Preview)
summary: When you need to understand unfamiliar code, compare approaches, or learn how a library or API works, a quick chat answer isn't always enough.[^c-ca9c324616] The research agent runs deep research on a topic and produces a thorough, well-cited Markdown report by gathering and synthesizing information from your codebase, relevant GitHub repositories, and the web.[^c-3772f9705c]

title: Configure OAuth client credentials in mcp.json
summary: Some MCP servers expect you to authenticate with a specific, pre-registered OAuth client instead of relying on Dynamic Client Registration.[^c-7461e08426]

title: Enterprise-managed MCP authentication (Preview)
summary: If your organization centralizes sign-in at a single identity provider (like Entra, Okta, or Auth0), you probably don't want every MCP server running its own Dynamic Client Registration against its own authorization server.[^c-8622706dda]

title: Delayed extension auto-updates
summary: VS Code now applies a two-hour delay before automatically updating extensions to a newly published version.[^c-11dc40b722] When automatic updates are enabled, new versions are auto-updated two hours after they are published, adding an extra layer of protection against problematic or potentially compromised releases.[^c-bef4e44b56]

title: GitHub Universe is back: All together now, in the agentic era
summary: GitHub Universe is back: returning to the historic Fort Mason Center in San Francisco on October 28–29, 2026.[^c-393c0aa103] If you’ve been following all the AI agent conversations and wondering what’s useful versus what’s just noise, you’re not alone.[^c-8d22d3bbd7]

title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio — May update
summary: May 2026 brought sharper tooling for planning, reviewing, and managing your work with GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio 2026.[^c-d56fa5fe02]

title: Enterprise Teams is now generally available
summary: Enterprise Teams is now generally available on GitHub Enterprise Cloud.[^c-49516b219d]

title: Copilot Chat brings richer context to pull requests
summary: GitHub Copilot Chat now provides richer context and new capabilities when you’re working with diffs and pull requests on github.com.[^c-b8eaf37bd8]

title: Larger context windows and configurable reasoning levels for GitHub Copilot
summary: GitHub Copilot now supports larger context windows and configurable reasoning levels to help you tackle deeper, more complex work.[^c-2415658b82]

title: API access to billing usage reports now generally available
summary: The REST API for enterprise administrators to request and download billing usage reports in .csv format is now generally available.[^c-47e515d3db] With this new capability, the same billing reports that are available in the UI can now be programmatically created.[^c-d645034bf9]

title: Budget and usage management APIs now generally available
summary: GitHub’s expanded billing APIs to programmatically manage budgets, track usage, and access cost center data are now generally available.[^c-2d969efa0e]

title: Agent tasks REST API now available for Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max
summary: Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max users can now programmatically start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks with the Agent tasks REST API, available in public preview.[^c-9314902579] Copilot cloud agent works in the background in its own development environment, where it can make and validate code changes, then open a pull request.[^c-fc5bf7a9f4] The API makes it easy to weave Copilot cloud agent into custom automations.[^c-f8b4f84604]

title: Fix with Copilot for failing Actions now in Pro, Pro+, and Max
summary: When a GitHub Actions job fails, Copilot Pro, Pro+, and Max subscribers can now ask Copilot cloud agent to fix it in one click.[^c-72f7fa2450] Click the Fix with Copilot button on the workflow run logs page, and Copilot will investigate the failure, push a fix to your branch, and tag you for review when it’s done.[^c-63dce686d3]

title: Enterprise-managed plugins in VS Code in public preview
summary: Last month we launched a public preview with Copilot CLI that allows enterprise administrators the ability to configure and distribute plugins to GitHub Copilot CLI users across their enterprise.[^c-f857be5876] VS Code release version 1.122 adds support for this enterprise-managed capability.[^c-d8947aa1c7] The baseline standards you set for your enterprise apply to every user’s Copilot CLI and VS Code clients.[^c-1336c050d1]

title: CodeQL 2.25.6 adds Swift 6.3.2 support and improves C# coverage
GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex deprecated
summary: As of today, June 5, 2026, we have deprecated the following models across most GitHub Copilot experiences (including Copilot Chat, inline edits, ask and agent modes, and code completions).[^c-d4a515ab78] Note that GPT-5.2 is still available as part of Copilot code review.[^c-23321407bf]

title: GitHub for Beginners: Answers to some common questions
summary: Find the answers to some of the most common GitHub-related questions.[^c-1c97371d1c] Welcome back to GitHub for Beginners.[^c-ea2ae6e035]

title: IP allow list coverage for EMU namespaces in general availability
summary: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Enterprise Managed Users (EMUs) can now enforce GitHub’s native IP allow list configuration across user namespaces.[^c-b89e929875]

title: Crane: verified code migration
summary: Crane is a migration assistant for GitHub repositories that plans, executes, and verifies code migrations in small agentic steps while keeping humans in control.[^c-c291c9874e]

title: From one-off prompts to workflows: How to use custom agents in GitHub Copilot CLI
summary: Custom agents let GitHub Copilot CLI understand your stack and team workflows, turning one-off terminal prompts into repeatable, reviewable processes.[^c-354bad18cb] Developers work across many surfaces like the CLI, IDE, and GitHub.[^c-457de58904] The terminal is often where they turn to move fast, automate tasks, or work directly with systems and scripts.[^c-a60e4ba536]

title: Security validation for third-party coding agents
summary: Security validation for third-party coding agents is now generally available.[^c-2a68e1906f] GitHub supports third-party coding agents (including Claude and OpenAI Codex) that work directly within your repositories to implement features, fix bugs, and improve test coverage.[^c-a624433cb2] Now, code generated by these agents receives the same automatic security validation already available for GitHub Copilot cloud agent.[^c-1b7d7a0c5b]

title: Periodic code scanning of inactive repositories
summary: GitHub code scanning now supports scheduled security scans of repositories that have had no pushes or pull requests for six months or more.[^c-18e7c1bf15] Organizations can use this to maintain continuous security coverage across all their repositories, including codebases that are no longer under active development.[^c-ce45b4a4de]

title: Claude Fable 5 is generally available for GitHub Copilot
summary: Claude Fable 5 from Anthropic is now available in GitHub Copilot, the first model in Anthropic’s Mythos class, designed for long-horizon, autonomous coding and knowledge-work tasks.[^c-234dc0fbcf] Unlike other Claude models in GitHub Copilot, Claude Fable 5 requires data retention to operate Anthropic’s safety classifiers.[^c-4183cab940]

title: Upcoming breaking changes for npm v12
Dependabot version updates now support the Deno ecosystem
Give GitHub Copilot CLI real code intelligence with language servers
summary: Install and configure LSP servers for GitHub Copilot CLI, replacing brute-force grep/decompile with real code intelligence.[^c-3286764047]

title: Enterprises can now create up to 500 cost centers
summary: The maximum number of cost centers you can create per enterprise has doubled from 250 to 500.[^c-9da2d352e0] If your enterprise spans hundreds or thousands of business units, departments, or product groups, you can now map cost centers more closely to your internal structure.[^c-765c37e036] That means more granular tracking, allocation, and reporting of usage and spend across your organization, without running into the previous limit.[^c-19646fbe48]

title: Manage sub-issues, types, and dependencies from GitHub CLI
summary: GitHub CLI now exposes issue types, parent and sub-issue relationships, and issue dependencies directly from the terminal.[^c-9b12d245d7]

title: List, view, and create discussions in GitHub CLI
summary: GitHub Discussions now has a first-class home in GitHub CLI through the new gh discussion command group.[^c-497f17b735]

title: Dedicated security review command now available in Copilot CLI
summary: You can now run a security review on your code changes directly from GitHub Copilot CLI.[^c-69cd53353e] The new /security-review slash command is shipping as an experimental feature in public preview, giving you a fast, AI-driven way to catch security vulnerabilities before they reach production code.[^c-54eb173b63]

title: Incremental analysis for Go, C/C++, and CodeQL CLI
summary: CodeQL scans on pull requests for C/C++ and Go now run incrementally, making them faster.[^c-fa4d8141b5] Earlier this year, we released improved incremental analysis for CodeQL analysis of C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Ruby.[^c-b9dcc137f7]

title: Copilot Chat now sees your agent sessions
GitHub Next and the Future of Coding
summary: Why AI makes typing code obsolete, and why engineering teams must shift from writing syntax to curating agent-generated code and mastering architectural judgment.[^c-86a3c5e1bf]

title: Navigate between sessions
summary: When you work across many agent sessions, being able to find and switch between them quickly matters.[^c-bdfd5407d5]

title: Restore sessions on reload
summary: Reloading or reopening the Agents window no longer loses your layout.[^c-523fd0cdec] The previously visible sessions and their state are restored automatically, so you land back where you left off.[^c-e1193df66c]

title: Close all sessions
summary: Similar to editor's Close All... commands, you can now close all your sessions in one step with the new Close All Sessions command.[^c-4cb5c7caa1]

title: Single-file diff in the Changes view (Preview)
summary: By default, selecting a file in the Changes view opens the multi-file diff editor.[^c-54cd7c3842]

title: Widen the editor with the side bar chevron
summary: When you open a file inside the Agents window, a chevron toggle now appears in the editor title bar, to the right of the tabs.[^c-d96e2ce8ba] Select it to collapse the secondary side bar (auxiliary bar) and widen the editor, and select it again to bring the side bar back.[^c-240d023108] The chevron direction reflects the current side bar visibility.[^c-e68a69411f]

title: Autopilot is enabled by default
summary: Autopilot is now enabled by default in VS Code.[^c-604f76c7b7]

title: Advanced Autopilot
summary: Knowing when an agent has truly finished a task is hard.[^c-ce0d7ee03d] Stop too early and the work is incomplete, loop too long and you waste time and tokens.[^c-f5354a70d1] Advanced Autopilot changes how Autopilot (Preview) decides when to keep iterating and when to finish, so you get more complete results without manually monitoring the loop.[^c-0bb85ecc11]

title: Create folder when opening folder from simple file dialog
Integrated Browser
summary: The integrated browser now retains the history of visited pages.[^c-7bd1cbe929]

title: Making secret scanning more trustworthy: Reducing false positives at scale
summary: Alerts are more trustworthy and actionable when noise is reduced.[^c-0356b92857] See how we improved the verification step with context-aware LLM reasoning.[^c-30fd114392] Secret scanning plays a critical role in protecting developers and organizations.[^c-296e6db3dd]

title: GitHub availability report: May 2026
summary: In May, we experienced nine incidents that resulted in degraded performance across GitHub services.[^c-e3f38e1550] In March and April we shared updates on GitHub’s availability and infrastructure investments.[^c-ce2c284f94] As that work continues and we approach some major milestones, we wanted to start sharing more regular updates in our monthly availability reports.[^c-9ad1231bfd]

title: Agentic workflows no longer need a personal access token
Bot-created pull requests can run workflows if approved
summary: Pull requests created by the github-actions[bot] are now able to run your CI/CD workflows with user approval.[^c-8213872da3] Requiring approval is a security measure to ensure generated code does not automatically run workflows which may have access to sensitive information.[^c-8eb8609511]

title: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview
summary: GitHub Agentic Workflows is now in public preview.[^c-b018391213] With agentic workflows, you can automate reasoning-based tasks like issue triage, CI failure analysis, and documentation updates by leveraging coding agents inside GitHub Actions.[^c-1f51beacd0] Define your automation in natural language Markdown files, and GitHub Agentic Workflows compiles them into standard Actions YAML.[^c-20190ca010]

title: New runner images in public preview
summary: Two new GitHub-hosted runner images for GitHub Actions are now available in public preview for all users, giving you early access to test your workflows on the latest platforms before they reach general availability.[^c-ca5d61983d]

title: Copilot CLI: Configure everything from one place with /settings
summary: GitHub Copilot CLI now has a unified, schema-driven home for configuration.[^c-d4c2412b8e]

title: AI usage report updates
summary: Your AI usage reports now reflect GitHub AI Credits usage in the standard report fields.[^c-c012d93890] To monitor AI credit usage going forward, use quantity for AI credit quantity and gross_amount for the dollar amount.[^c-6acc4a9abb]

title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.21 is now generally available
summary: GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) 3.21 enhances deployment efficiency, monitoring capabilities, code security, and policy management.[^c-1c42653e36]

title: Review pull requests without leaving Visual Studio
